title: Selected single command
purpose: Cover the canonical single-command parser path with an explicit ON state and select qualifier.
expected_behavior: The peer parses a TypeID 45 single command addressed to information-object address 1, with ON state and the select bit set.
constraints_preserved: The command qualifier combines ON state 1 with select bit 1
The I-format length 0x0e equals four APCI control bytes plus the 10-byte ASDU
The information-object address is three bytes and the common address is two bytes
issue_safety_notes: Uses ordinary bounded command fields and a source-listed TypeID; it is not an exact historical payload collision.
